classes.description: Never retry with the same card. The customer has to give another payment method.
The issuer cannot approve now. Retry later, within the network's limits.
The card data was wrong or out of date. Retry only after it is corrected.
The customer has to do something first: authenticate, enter a PIN, confirm new card details.
A failure between the networks or systems. Retry soon, within the network's limits.

reasons.description: The account does not have enough funds.
The issuer declined without saying why.
Declined for a reason the issuer did not specify.
The issuer asks to be contacted (refer to card issuer).
An amount or frequency limit on the card was exceeded.
The amount is not valid or not supported for this card.
The card cannot be used here, for example in this region.
The account is temporarily blocked.
The cardholder blocked this kind of payment.
This kind of transaction is not permitted for the card.
The issuer does not accept the merchant.
The issuer suspects fraud.
Too many incorrect PIN entries.
The issuer or the switch could not be reached.
An error occurred while processing.
The issuer asks to submit the transaction again.
The card has expired or the expiry date is missing.
The security code (CVV2, CVC) check failed.
The PIN is incorrect or missing.
The cardholder's details do not match the issuer's records.
The customer has to authenticate, for example with 3-D Secure.
The issuer asks for the PIN.
The card has new details; update them before trying again.
The card is reported lost.
The card is reported stolen.
The issuer asks to keep the card.
The issuer flagged the account as fraudulent.
The card number does not exist.
The account is closed, does not exist, or the issuer is unknown.
The cardholder ordered the issuer to stop this payment.
The cardholder revoked the authorization for this merchant.
The cardholder revoked all recurring authorizations.
The issuer or network says not to try again.
The same transaction was already submitted; check for an existing payment instead of retrying.
The account behind the card changed: closed, expired or replaced. Mastercard code 79.
The issuer declined under its own policy. Mastercard code 82.
